descriptor.retrieval_description: Smooth, curved miniature bell pepper with a glossy, dry, nonporous skin. The intended contact region is clean with continuous curvature and no visible seams or interruptions.
descriptor.contact_region: The lateral opposing sides of the miniature pepper within the centered grasp band.
descriptor.local_geometry: Smooth convex curvature tapering slightly along the length
descriptor.uncertainty: The side facing away from the camera is not visible, but the grasp band surfaces are fully observable.
